title.ko: 혼합 조건문: if + had + p.p., would + 동사원형 / if + 과거형, would have + p.p.
title.en: mixed conditionals: if + past perfect, would + base verb / if + past simple, would have + past participle

explain.ko: 혼합 조건문은 if절과 주절의 시간이 다를 때 씁니다. 첫째, 과거에 일어나지 않은 일이 지금의 결과에 영향을 줄 때는 If + had + 과거분사, would + 동사원형을 씁니다(If I had invested early, I would be rich now). 둘째, 지금의 성격이나 상태가 과거의 행동에 영향을 줄 때는 If + 과거형, would have + 과거분사를 씁니다(If I were more careful, I wouldn't have made that mistake). 혼합 조건문은 과거 선택과 현재 모습을 연결해 인생을 이야기하거나 후회를 표현할 때 자주 사용합니다.
explain.en: Mixed conditionals link different times. First, a past unreal event with a present result: If + past perfect, would + base verb (If I had invested early, I would be rich now). Second, a present state or trait that would have changed a past action: If + past simple, would have + past participle (If I were more careful, I wouldn't have made that mistake). They are common when talking about life choices and regrets.

rows: If + had + p.p., would + base verb
If I had studied law, I would be a lawyer now.

If I were braver, I would have spoken up.
If + hadn't + p.p., wouldn't + base verb
If I hadn't moved, I wouldn't know you now.

notes.ko: if절과 주절의 시간을 따로 판단합니다. 각각이 과거인지 현재인지 먼저 확인하세요.
notes.en: Decide the time of each clause separately: is each one past or present?

notes.ko: if절에는 would를 쓰지 않습니다. If I would have … 는 틀린 표현입니다.
notes.en: Do not use would in the if-clause: If I would have … is wrong.

notes.ko: might나 could를 쓰면 확실하지 않은 결과를 말할 수 있습니다.
notes.en: Use might or could for uncertain results.

prompt.ko: 과거의 선택이 지금에 미친 영향을 혼합 조건문으로 4문장 써 보세요.
prompt.en: Write 4 sentences about how a past choice affects your life now, using mixed conditionals.

must_include.label: If + had + p.p., would + base verb
If + past simple, would have + p.p.

task.model: If I had gone to graduate school, I would be a researcher now. But I chose a job, so I work for a company. If I were more adventurous, I would have moved abroad back then. Still, I don't regret that decision.

model_trans.ko: 그때 대학원에 진학했더라면 지금 연구자가 되어 있을 거예요. 하지만 취직을 선택했기 때문에 지금은 회사에서 일하고 있어요. 내가 더 모험심이 강한 사람이라면 그때 해외로 떠났을 거예요. 그래도 그 결정을 후회하지는 않아요.
model_trans.en: If I had gone to graduate school, I would be a researcher now. But I chose a job, so I work for a company. If I were more adventurous, I would have moved abroad back then. Still, I don't regret that decision.
